searchText: > so if my 30m gas call places a byte at memory location 30_000_000 then the child will get zero memory yes > And setting that byte to 1 and then to zero still leaves the "high water mark" for that frame? yes In proposal 3, a similar rule exists but it's quadratic instead of linear So instead of `max_child_gas = parent_gas - len(parent_memory) * k`, it's `sqrt(max_child_gas) = sqrt(parent_gas) - len(parent_memory) * k` So you still have a max total memory length invariant ok wow I did not realize that there were still ethereum impls that use the cache model (instead of a journal) wow why?
